review_contract.issue_test: On each candidate, identify the exact proposition asserted and the local evidence offered for it. A candidate is an issue when the wording adds authorial self-justification, an unsupported self-deprecation, an empty disclaimer, or a value judgment about omitted work beyond the facts, scope limits and necessary uncertainty that the text must keep.
review_contract.repair_test: Record issue_present before proposing an edit, then facts_preserved, strength_preserved and issue_removed with a preservation_reason. A revision keeps the modal strength and degree in either direction. Deleting a whole sentence requires the focused removal_preserves check.
review_contract.counting: Only confirmed and partial assert a defect. Only confirmed offers an accepted repair. KEEP and optional are not detection errors. unresolved is unknown.

claim_negation.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` contain a sentence or clause stating a negation of a claim, that is, saying what the method, paper, model or result does not do, does not claim, does not prove, does not provide, does not include, or judging something to have no value? Markers: do not claim, not intended to, should not be taken to mean, is not a, there is no benefit, no need to, we are not; 并不声称、无意、不意味着、不应被理解为、不代表、不涉及、没有价值、无需.

criteria.true: At least one sentence or clause explicitly negates a claim or capability
criteria.false: No sentence or clause explicitly negates a claim or capability

negative_contrast.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` contain a 'not X but Y', 'rather than', 'instead of', or 'as opposed to' contrast used to redirect an expected reading? Markers: 并非…而是、不是…而是、与其说…不如说.

criteria.true: At least one such contrast construction is present
criteria.false: No such contrast construction is present

vague_hedge.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` contain a vague weakening word or phrase that lowers the force of a statement without naming the source of uncertainty? Markers: could hardly, may potentially, to some extent, it should be noted, of course; 仅、只能、初步、难以、尚不能、仍有提升空间、在一定程度上、或许. Do not count an explicit prohibition or a required restriction, such as 不得、must not、cannot be used, or a condition that names the specific case it governs.

criteria.true: At least one such vague weakening expression is present and it is not a prohibition or a condition that names its case
criteria.false: No such weakening expression, or the negative wording is a prohibition or a named condition

concessive_hedge.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` use a concessive construction that softens, pre-frames or walks back the authors' own claim or result, rather than reporting a genuine contrast between two reported findings? Markers: although, while, however, even though; 虽然、尽管、但、然而. Do not count a concession whose two sides are both reported measurements, and do not count a concession that introduces a necessary scope or condition rather than retreating from a claim.

criteria.true: A concessive construction softens or walks back the authors' own claim rather than contrasting two reported findings
criteria.false: No concessive construction, or the concession contrasts two reported findings or introduces a necessary scope condition

effort_assurance.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` contain a generalized assurance about the authors' own effort, rigor, diligence, integrity, completeness or value, presented without naming a checkable artifact, method, quantity or location? Markers: make every effort, we ensure, we have ensured, we report every, we carefully, we rigorously, to the best of our knowledge, we are confident, we are not framing, we do not overstate; 我们尽力、我们确保、我们逐一报告、我们严格、据我们所知、我们有信心. Do not count an assurance that names the concrete artifact or location that makes it checkable, and do not count a plain description of a procedure the authors performed.

criteria.true: At least one generalized self-assurance about effort, rigor, completeness or value is present and it names no checkable artifact, method, quantity or location
criteria.false: No such assurance, or the assurance names a checkable artifact, method, quantity or location

attribution_hedge.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` attribute a result or shortfall to a named mechanism, cause or difficulty using an unhedged belief or assertion, while supplying no comparison, citation, measurement or ablation in the same paragraph? Markers: we believe this is due to, this is because, this reflects, the reason is, this indicates that; 我们认为这是因为、这反映了、原因在于、这说明. Do not count a mechanism offered with explicit hypothesis modality and a concrete illustration, and do not count an attribution that cites a source or reports a comparison in the same paragraph.

criteria.true: At least one causal attribution is asserted with no comparison, citation, measurement or ablation in the same paragraph
criteria.false: No such attribution, or the attribution is supported by a comparison, citation, measurement or ablation in the same paragraph

completeness_assurance.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` assert that the authors reported, ran, checked or disclosed the complete set of analyses, results or checks, or justify the presence of auxiliary material by its completeness or audit value, rather than naming what each item establishes? Markers: we report every, we report all, we ran every, including the two, none of it is needed to read, all of it is needed to check, we disclose all; 我们报告了全部、我们逐一报告、包含其余、这些都不影响结论但都用于核对. Do not count a plain list of reported items without a completeness or audit-value claim.

criteria.true: A completeness or audit-value assurance is asserted without naming what each item establishes
criteria.false: No such assurance, or the sentence lists reported items without claiming completeness or audit value

omission_value_judgment.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` judge an omitted experiment, comparison, repetition or scope expansion to have no value, to be worthless, or to constitute scope creep, while giving no comparability, population or condition analysis? Markers: no benefit in repeating, not worth, scope creep, multiplies the experiments, pointless, unnecessary to repeat; 没有价值、不值得、范围蔓延、徒增实验. Do not count a documented design reason that names the cost, condition or comparison that makes the omission acceptable.

criteria.true: An omitted line of work is judged valueless or excess without a comparability, population or condition analysis
criteria.false: No such judgment, or the omission is justified by a named cost, condition or comparison

substantive_boundary.instructions: Does `paragraph.text` limit the reach of a claim by naming the concrete measurement, statistic, dataset, sample, study design element or analysis that limits it? Markers: not tested for statistical significance, descriptive, scoped to, limited to, single seed, one corpus, not evaluated clinically, cannot be confirmed, does not establish, no measurable, insufficiently powered; 未做统计检验、描述性、范围限于、受限于、单一语料、样本不足、未做临床评估、无法证实、不足以确立. Do not count a bare negation that names no such object.

criteria.true: A claim is limited by naming a concrete measurement, statistic, dataset, sample, design element or analysis
criteria.false: No such named limit, or the negation names no concrete object

controls.text: We do not claim that these cases are representative of all settings.
This paper is not intended to provide a comprehensive account of the phenomenon, but rather to examine one specific mechanism.
While the sample is limited and cannot capture every variation, it still offers useful insights.
This may potentially suggest that X could possibly be associated with Y.
We analyze four cases over the same period.
Under the same conditions the two estimates are 49.47% and 46.08%.

notes: The four observable questions and six controls are unchanged from v4. Review2 fixes contradictory semantic labels and separates issue detection from repair quality. A gate pass is run-specific and does not validate semantic decisions. New semantic cases are synthetic regression specifications, not measured classifier accuracy. Revision 0.27 adds an evidence-proposition match check for evaluative KEEP rationales and paired domain-neutral cases for scope, mixed-result interpretation, and design coherence.

two_stage.principle: The screen is a Jev-only decision. Stage 1 maximizes recall surface: a unit becomes a candidate when any active dimension reaches the gate threshold. Stage 2 assigns a confidence tier from the specialized dimensions only. The tier orders the report and records which dimension fired; it is not a separate review stage and it does not authorize an edit.

stage1_recall_gate.meaning: candidate enters review when any active dimension is at or above 0.5

stage2_confidence_tier.rule: tier_score = max(issue dimensions) - substantive_boundary; high >= 0.6, medium >= 0.2, else low
stage2_confidence_tier.note: substantive_boundary is a keep signal derived from the training split only: it fired on 7 of 62 training negatives and on none of the 9 training positives.

measured_on.labels: 119 audited sentences (18 confirmed defensive, 101 audited non-defensive)

validation_without_agent.note: the val split informed threshold choices, so this is not a held-out estimate

measured_on.note: Counts are a development-set measurement, not a general accuracy claim. The 101 audited non-defensive sentences come from a proposal pool and are not an exhaustive negative sample.
